why: Fix round: pull request 1507 could not merge, since origin/main had moved 12 commits past 9186e6c to 6c092dd and the merge conflicted in 8 files (.agents/skills/lead/scripts/land.ts, .agents/skills/lead/scripts/pr/Arm.test.ts, .github/ci/scheduled.mjs, .github/ci/scheduled.test.ts, .github/ci/workflow-lint/scheduled.ts, next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/edge-comment.integration.test.ts, next/packages/libfabrika/src/processes/Process.test-support.ts, oxlint-plugins/integration-test-name.ts). Each conflict was the sweep's blank lines against main's real rewrite, so each file took main's content and pnpm format put the rule's blank lines back. Pull request 1366's diff, read again (67 files), now holds next/packages/libfabrika/src/transport/Connection.ts, which the first sweep had spaced. It went back to main's content, which has hits, so libfabrika transport left the rule's block: 26 folders are locked and nine wait on 1366. oxlint-plugins/README.md says so. pnpm format spaced main's new and changed files in locked folders (16 files, blank lines only). Against origin/main the merge's only non-blank changes are the pull request's own: .oxlintrc.json's block, decision 0021's amendment, oxlint-plugins/README.md, the three test edits and the two field rows; no file of 1366's diff differs from main.
note: No new law and no plant: the round changes no law, and the two lint plants of the first row still hold for the block. Ran at the merged tree (main 6c092dd), in a cloud box: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 pnpm lint green (18 parts), the list ratchet exit 0, one pnpm typecheck green. Narrow vitest, nice -n 15 --maxWorkers=3, all green: .agents/skills/lead/scripts/pr/Arm.test.ts, .agents/skills/lead/scripts/land.test.ts, .github/ci/scheduled.test.ts, .github/ci/workflow-lint/scheduled.test.ts, next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/edge-comment.integration.test.ts, oxlint-plugins/integration-test-name.test.ts, oxlint-plugins/padding-line-between-statements.test.ts, oxlint-plugins/plants.test.ts, oxlint-plugins/anti-slop.test.ts, next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/one-store-hook.integration.test.ts, and three readers of Process.test-support.ts (runtime/internal/supervisor.laws.test.ts, runtime/internal/exitReason.test.ts, node/ExitReason.integration.test.ts). The merge was committed with plain git commit, since stepcommit.sh commits named paths and git refuses a partial commit during a merge.
